backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profiles, log entries, uploads, and questions with CRUD operations and role checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Human‑written summaries describing each major frontend file’s purpose across auth, layouts, pages, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base file defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup handling auth state, role‑based routing, header layout, and profile setup flow.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting new users to enter and save their display name.
frontend/src/components/header/AppHeader: Header with branding, login/logout actions, profile display, and navigation logic based on role.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor using the current Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities and exposing login and logout helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, logs, uploads, questions, and admin-related data via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining light and dark theme variables for layout and component styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, providing React Query and Internet Identity context providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardL: Renders the admin dashboard layout, computing summary stats and navigation for logs, documents, and questions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllDocumentsPag: Displays all user-uploaded documents with filtering, sorting, downloading, and viewing options for admins.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllLogsPage.tsx: Shows all user log entries with user-based filtering and sorted display for admin review.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllQuestionsPag: Admin interface to view, filter, update, and reply to user questions with status management.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Displays the login UI and redirects authenticated users to the appropriate dashboard based on admin status.
Allows users to upload, view, download, and manage their own documents with progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/user/MyLogsPage.tsx: Enables users to create, edit, delete, and view their personal log entries sorted by timestamp.
Renders the user's questions list with sorting, loading state, and a dialog for submitting new questions. Uses query hooks to fetch and create questions.
frontend/src/pages/user/UserDashboardLay: Provides the user dashboard layout with navigation tabs and redirects from /user to /user/logs. Renders nested routes via Outlet.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters. Supports both query-string and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, animations, shadows, and container settings. Includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing versioned features, requirements, issues, and asset needs for the web-based truck log application.
